Q6097.reason: Most states turn a fee tail into a fee simple absolute, so the cousin took the whole estate and the later deed left the niece nothing.

Q5137.reason: The doctor is proving what the x-rays show, and x-ray films are photographs whose content must be proved by the originals under the best-evidence rule.

Q5526.reason: The brick broke the window and entered as the instrument of the killing, so felonious intent existed at the moment of entry.
